title: Realtime Ripple
content:
Gravito provides first-class support for WebSockets via the Ripple orbit. Unlike standard WebSocket implementations, Ripple offers a channel-based broadcasting system out of the box.

Installation

bun add @gravito/ripple

Usage

Ripple attaches to your Photon server and handles connection upgrades automatically.

import { RippleServer } from '@gravito/ripple'

// Initialize Ripple
const ripple = new RippleServer({
  pingInterval: 30000
})

// Broadcast to a channel
app.post('/api/chat/send', async (c) => {
  const body = await c.req.json()
  ripple.to('chat-room-1').emit('message', body)
  return c.json({ sent: true })
})

// Handle upgrades
export default {
  fetch: app.fetch,
  websocket: ripple.getHandler()
}

Client-Side

Use the lightweight @gravito/ripple-client to connect.

import { useChannel } from '@gravito/ripple-client/react'

useChannel('chat-room-1', (event, data) => {
  console.log('New message:', data)
})
